story.title: Teenager Commits Deadly Shooting at School After Killing Grandparents in Thailand
story.summary: A 14-year-old boy in Thailand killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, resulting in at least eight deaths, including his own. The attack, which occurred just outside Bangkok, left more than 30 others injured. Authorities reported that the boy used a firearm belonging to his grandfather and fired a total of 26 rounds during the incident. The motive for the shooting remains unclear.

explore_lenses.label: How did a 14-year-old access the gun?
explore_lenses.title: A legally registered household gun is central
explore_lenses.summary: Authorities say the weapon was legally registered to the boy’s grandfather, shifting attention from unlawful purchase to a minor’s access to a gun kept at home. Thailand had already tightened licensing and public-carry rules, but the reporting reviewed does not establish how the firearm was stored or obtained by the boy.

claims.text: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said police described the gun as legally registered to the grandfather; police said the boy lived with his grandparents.

In February, the government ordered closer scrutiny of gun-purchase applicants and monitoring of possession-license holders, while continuing a suspension of new public-carry permits; it said a possession license does not itself authorize carrying a firearm in public.

The government’s licensing measures address purchasers, licensees and public carrying; whether they include, or were followed by, secure-storage safeguards in this household is unresolved in the sources reviewed.

explore_lenses.label: Was the school prepared for an attack?
explore_lenses.title: Prior preparedness did not prevent the attack
explore_lenses.summary: Debsirin Nonthaburi had publicly documented an active-shooter exercise in 2023, but an attack by one of its own students still unfolded after classes began. The available reporting describes students sheltering and police clearing them out, not whether the earlier plan was activated or where it broke down.

claims.text: The school published a December 2023 notice for an active-shooter response exercise, described in Thai as “run, hide, fight,” for a suspected person causing an incident at the school.
Police spokesperson Trairong Piwpan said the student attended school normally, waited until classes began, first fired in his classroom, then moved outside and continued shooting.

A witness told AP that students hid in a classroom until police knocked and led them out; that account supports that some sheltering and evacuation occurred, but does not show whether it followed the school’s formal drill procedure.

explore_lenses.label: What help and investigation come next?
explore_lenses.title: Immediate aid is announced; motive remains open
explore_lenses.summary: The immediate official response is focused on school closure, victim assistance and a police investigation. Officials have offered preliminary accounts of stress and premeditation, but these are not yet a confirmed motive, and early casualty reports were inconsistent.

claims.text: The school said classes would be suspended from August 10 through August 14, with staff instructed to work from home during that period.

The Prime Minister’s Office said it ordered urgent assistance for victims and families; a disaster-relief fund committee was to consider payments using prior-case benchmarks of 1 million baht for a death, 700,000 for disability, 200,000 for serious injury and 100,000 for minor injury.
Anutin said the student had shown school-related stress, while ABC reported he characterized the attack as premeditated; neither statement establishes a final motive.
AP reported 23 wounded, including 10 in critical condition, and noted earlier conflicting casualty totals; the final death and injury toll therefore remained subject to confirmation.

story_report.summary: A 14-year-old boy killed his grandparents before opening fire at Debsirin Nonthaburi School near Bangkok, authorities said. At least eight people, including the shooter, died, and more than 30 others were injured. Police said he used a gun belonging to his grandfather, which Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said was legally registered. The school suspended classes for the following week as authorities arranged assistance for victims and families.

sections.heading: School Response Preparations
sections.body: The school had published a December 2023 notice for an active-shooter response exercise described as “run, hide, fight.” Police spokesperson Trairong Piwpan said the student attended school normally, waited for classes to begin, fired first in his classroom and then moved outside, where he continued shooting. A witness told AP that students hid in a classroom until police knocked and led them out.

sections.heading: Victim Aid and School Closure
sections.body: The Prime Minister’s Office said it ordered urgent assistance for victims and their families. A disaster-relief fund committee was to consider compensation based on previous cases, including 1 million baht for a death, 700,000 baht for disability, 200,000 baht for serious injury and 100,000 baht for minor injury. The school said classes would be suspended from Aug. 10 to Aug. 14, while staff were instructed to work from home.

sections.heading: Firearm Licensing Rules
sections.body: The government in February ordered closer scrutiny of gun-purchase applicants and monitoring of possession-license holders, while maintaining a suspension of new public-carry permits. It said a possession license does not itself authorize someone to carry a firearm in public. The measures address purchasers, licensees and public carrying, but the reviewed sources do not establish whether secure-storage requirements applied in the grandparents’ household or were followed.

unresolved.text: Police had not publicly explained how the boy obtained or transported his grandfather’s firearm as of Aug. 7, 2026.
No official after-action account was available to establish whether the school’s active-shooter drill procedures were followed during the attack.
The final casualty toll remained subject to confirmation; AP reported 23 wounded, including 10 in critical condition, amid earlier conflicting totals.

A final motive had not been established. Anutin cited school-related stress and ABC reported that he described the attack as premeditated, but the shooter’s death means investigators must reconstruct intent from other evidence.

related_stories.title: Surveillance Video Released of Deadly Shooting at Idaho In-N-Out Burger
related_stories.summary: Police have released surveillance footage from a mass shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, which occurred last weekend. The video shows the gunman approaching the drive-thru window multiple times and opening fire, resulting in three fatalities and seven injuries. The incident has been described as chaotic, with bystanders attempting to assist the victims.

related_stories.title: Masseur Describes Maradona's Condition Before Death Amid Ongoing Negligence Trial
related_stories.summary: A masseur has described Diego Maradona as bloated, bedridden, and resigned in the days leading up to his death in 2020. This testimony comes as seven healthcare professionals are on trial in Argentina, facing allegations of negligence that may have contributed to the football legend's passing.
